SELECT c.* FROM agent_execution_tool_call c JOIN agent_execution e ON e.id=c.execution_id
ORDER BY c.started_at DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN c.tool_source = 'SKILL_LOCAL' THEN 'SKILL_LOCAL' WHEN c.mcp_server_id IS NULL AND c.tool_source_key = 'workbench' THEN 'WORKBENCH_MCP' ELSE 'EXTERNAL_MCP' END AS source, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM agent_execution_tool_call c JOIN agent_execution e ON e.id=c.execution_id
GROUP BY CASE WHEN c.tool_source = 'SKILL_LOCAL' THEN 'SKILL_LOCAL' WHEN c.mcp_server_id IS NULL AND c.tool_source_key = 'workbench' THEN 'WORKBENCH_MCP' ELSE 'EXTERNAL_MCP' END
